thesis: Evanston Capital Management initially viewed the crypto space as interesting but not ready for institutional capital until the 2018 winter, when they observed a shift toward managers with technical backgrounds and institutional-grade infrastructure. After conducting deep diligence on the underlying technology and use cases, they concluded that Multicoin Capital was a conviction investment that aligned with their firm's DNA of investing with concentration to generate alpha.
